claim_ceiling: Finite composition of owner-produced synthetic claims only; each decision preserves the complete source input snapshot and requires time scale, profile, horizontal frame and vertical datum identity. Not flight authorization, conflict-free proof, dispatch, DAA, separation assurance, aircraft control, airworthiness or certification.
identity_contract: Every contributing owner identity must exactly match expected time scale, profile and frame.
positive_disposition_semantics: READY_FOR_CONFLICT_SCREEN only; unresolved possible occupancy is preserved.

generated_fault_campaign.expected_invariant: Every mutated input is not READY_FOR_CONFLICT_SCREEN and returns no partial occupancy list; separate positive control remains required.
generated_fault_campaign.note: The generated campaign complements, but does not alter, the 28 curated golden fixture cases. It is not exhaustive over all possible input values or higher-order interactions.
